parallelGroups.condition: Disjoint owned files and bounded resource slots; these need not run simultaneously.
Frozen domain contract; query implementation cannot edit domain owner files.

serialization.owner: domain subLead for domain fields; root for integration
serialization.rule: One writer; consumers use pinned contract revision; incompatible change returns to exact review.

serialization.resource: package.json, lockfiles, CI/check routing, source maps
serialization.rule: Leaf workers submit bounded patches; root applies in exact source order with semantic transitions.

serialization.resource: private source access, DB changes, print/send/deployment/native config
serialization.rule: Current effect hold; Git worktrees do not isolate these resources.
Initially at most two owned active agent turns including root, one heavy build/test at a time. Observe existing load and reduce concurrency; do not control unrelated agents.

tabPolicy.reviewer: Independent child pane in root Work tab; no implementer role. Another Work receives another tab only after approval.
tabPolicy.defaultWorkerRuntime: Select a qualified available native runtime at dispatch; do not allocate unavailable environments for coverage theater.
tabPolicy.existingTabs: Never seize, reassign or message unrelated active tabs; prior owners and holds retained.
tabPolicy.plannedTabIds: null until created; never predict Herdr public IDs.

reviewer.sourcePolicy: Exact immutable repair successor with original approved design and first independent review preserved; actual native launch is in checkpoint/delegation receipts, not this design-time assignment.
reviewer.writeScope: Only reviewer-owned typed review receipts; no student contents, services, configuration or remote effects.
reviewer.noFallback: If model/effort is not actually available, retain the requested assignment and report the exact gap; do not silently substitute.

integrationPolicy.formalCompletion: Requires actual delivery/acceptance prerequisites; local tests alone are insufficient.
integrationPolicy.finalVerification: VER-03 consumes final CON-03 closure; INT-VERIFY consumes the actual integrated commit/tree. Any closure hash change invalidates applicable previous evidence and requires a new bounded check.

crossWorkProtocol: cross-work-protocol-r3.json; same existing canonical APIs and receiver-owned local qualification Tasks.
